asset.name: AppNotificationSettings
asset.description: A scenario's own notification settings: show its notifications in its installed app instead of Chimesail on this device, plus on/off and minimum urgency for each of its notification types.

requires.reason: Turn on, turn off, retry and confirm actions use the shared button.
The device pairing choice is a shared card radio group.
Each notification type's minimum urgency is a shared select.
Each notification type's on/off choice is a shared switch.

rationale: Every scenario with app delivery needs the same pairing and per-type preference surface over the shared /vrooli-notify routes served by @vrooli/api-base/server.
